messages.author: 32bf4f27a31a68db
messages.subject: rstan returns empty object
parts:
Hi,

Testing out some new models in rstan.  The object that is supposed to hold the samples comes back empty.  In fact, it seems to be non-existent.

post <- stan(....)

> print(post)
> str(post)
> type(post)
> class(post)

R doesn't even seem to recognize the object.  

The model runs fine,  I can see it warmup and sampling.  No errors are reported.  Just a weird empty object.

Software details:
R version 3.4.0  GUI 1.70 El Capitan Build (7338)


Has anyone seen this before?  Any suggestions?

Thanks!

messages.author: fc5d3270037d7478
messages.subject: Re: rstan returns empty object
parts:
Hi Noah, 

Hmm, I haven't heard of that happening before. Does this problem occur with all Stan models you run or only with a particular model? For example, what happens if you run one of the demos: 

fit <- stan_demo("eight_schoools")

Does the fit object exist afterwards?

Jonah
